artworks.title: Shepherd with a Platerspiel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 9.7 x 7.6 cm (3 13/16 x 3 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure playing a flute while kneeling. Detailed vegetation is closest to us, with a herd of sheep gathered under a large tree. A stone structure with a window and hilly terrain leading to mountains are in the background. Wispy clouds can be seen in the sky. The artwork is monochrome with cross-hatching and line work for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Artois
artworks.medium: pen and red ink and watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing, turned slightly to the side, facing the viewer. The person's left arm holds a bundle wrapped in light cloth tucked under their right arm, with a basket hanging from their right arm. The facial features include defined cheekbones, a somewhat pronounced chin, and a thoughtful expression. They wear a dark-colored cap with a patterned red scarf tied over it and under the chin. The clothing includes a multicolored, striped garment, a red shawl draped over the shoulders, a blue skirt, and brown shoes. The background is a neutral tone with no distinct scenery.

artworks.title: Journée du 10 Aout 1792
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene set in front of an elaborate architectural structure. The image shows a battle occurring along the courtyard of a grand building with low, wide wings and a central domed section. Soldiers can be seen engaged in combat, wielding rifles with fixed bayonets and operating cannons. Smoke billows across the scene. The building in the background appears to be a significant edifice, characterized by its long façade, numerous windows, and classical architectural features. The drawing captures both the energy of the skirmish and the majesty of the architecture, creating a contrast between the human conflict in the foreground and the stately structure behind.

artworks.title: La Fontaine de la Régénération sur les débris de la Bastille, le 10 Aout 1793
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large gathering in front of a statue. The composition features a multitude of figures gathered around a raised platform supporting a prominent statue. The statue represents a seated figure. Surrounding the statue, numerous trees contribute to the setting. Architectural elements in the background suggest a historical or cultural location for the event depicted. The foreground is densely populated with figures in various poses, indicating dynamic movement and engagement with the scene.

artworks.title: Ouverture des Etats-Généraux à Versailles, le 5 mars 1789
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in an opulent hall with columns, detailed ceilings decorated with oval medallions and floral patterns. Symmetrically placed marble columns support an entablature leading to a throne-like area. Numerous figures in formal attire are gathered in rows, engaged in an event or ceremony directed at a stage with a raised platform. The perspective adds depth, emphasizing the spacious and elaborate interior.

artworks.title: Pompe funèbre en l'honneur des Martyrs de la journée du 10, dans le Jardin National le 26 Aout 1792
artworks.description: The image shows a public gathering with a low horizon line near the bottom third of the composition. The horizon is marked by a grand architectural structure with domed towers. A crowd of people is gathered, dressed in period attire. They are focused towards a central event where smoke and a pyramid-shaped structure can be seen. The artwork features detailed line work with hatching and cross-hatching, typical of an engraving technique. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by varying shades of black, white, and gray. Large, swirling clouds fill the sky above the gathering.

artworks.title: Journée du 16 Octobre 1793 [exécution de Marie-Antoinette]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a public execution scene in an outdoor setting with a guillotine. The drawing captures a detailed scene in a large open area, likely a city square, where a guillotine stands elevated on a platform, surrounded by a dense crowd. To the left of the image, a grand equestrian statue adds a dramatic flair, depicting a horse and rider with an elaborate pedestal. In the background, there are buildings and various architectural elements, including a column or tower, and tall trees lining the scene on the right. At the far right, another statue is perched, sitting on a high base. The drawing conveys a historical or significant event, with careful attention to the interaction and focus of the crowd encircling the central action of the guillotine.

artworks.title: Fédération Générale de Français, au Champ de Mars, le 14 Juillet 1790
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a large procession from an elevated viewpoint. A crowd of people are close to us, with spectators at the edges waving and cheering. In the distance, rows of figures extend toward arches. Hills, trees, buildings, and a church are visible in the background. The etching style uses precise strokes to depict people, architecture, and nature. The color palette is sepia, giving the drawing an antiquated appearance with clear visuals.

artworks.title: The Sower
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a person in mid-stride. The individual is depicted with their left foot forward, right arm extended to the side, and wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The figure is dressed in loose-fitting clothes, including a jacket or shirt and pants, and appears to be carrying a bag over the shoulder with the left hand. The sketch is done on blue-toned paper with a simple background.

artworks.title: The Newborn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures carrying a calf on a branch-like stretcher. The drawing features two elongated, sketchy figures standing apart, facing away from each other, each holding an end of a horizontal branch. Upon this branch lies the outline of a calf, suggesting it is being transported by these looming figures. The figures wear hats and loose clothing, their forms subtly suggested by soft graphite or charcoal strokes against a pale blue paper. This sketching technique gives the drawing an impression of gentle movement and fluid action, primarily using simple lines and minimal detail. The overall composition is balanced by the symmetry of the two figures' poses, and the drawing captures a calm and muted rustic atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Large Shepherdess (La grande bergere)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing outdoors, holding a staff. Their head is slightly turned down and covered by a hood or cap. They are wearing a long robe or cloak made of a heavy, textured fabric, with detailed cross-hatching. In the background, there are trees, foliage, and sheep grazing, creating a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: The Diggers (Les becheurs)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals actively working in a field. One person is using a long-handled tool to dig into the ground, while the other person is standing nearby with a similar tool. Both individuals have short hair and wear long-sleeved tops and trousers. One person wears a cap, and the other's hat is on the ground. The ground is rough with rocks and sparse vegetation. The background shows an open landscape with distant hills and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Man with Wheelbarrow (Le paysan rentrant du fumier)
artworks.description: The image features a person pushing a wheelbarrow filled with hay or straw. The individual is wearing work attire, a hat, and sturdy shoes. The background includes a stone structure, a rustic wooden gate, a thatched roof, and foliage or trees, situated in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Departure for Work (Le depart pour le travail)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman walking side by side. The woman is on the left, wearing a long dress and a bonnet, and holding a jug. The man is on the right, wearing a long-sleeved shirt, pants, and a wide-brimmed hat, carrying a pitchfork. The background depicts a rural setting with fields, sparse vegetation, some trees, and a lightly sketched sky with a few clouds.

artworks.title: Earl Spencer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man holding a book with both hands. He has a stern facial expression and is dressed in a formal outfit, including a long dark coat with lapels and a star-shaped insignia on the right side. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Pendant
artworks.description: This image features intricately designed ornate letters of the alphabet surrounded by elaborate illustrations. The top of the composition shows a cherub riding on an eagle, holding a crown above their head. A ribbon with inscriptions unfurls around the crown, and a sun with a human face is visible in the corner. The letters "A," "F," "D," "H," and another "H" are decorated with classical elements like putti, garlands, and mythological figures. The central panel is adorned with heraldic symbols, angelic figures, and coats of arms. The overall style of the artwork reflects baroque or renaissance decorative artistry, known for its ornamental details and classical themes.

artworks.title: Arms of Charles II, Duc de Mantoue
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms held by two angels. The image depicts a shield with various heraldic symbols such as fleur-de-lis, eagles, and geometric designs. The shield is crowned with a detailed crown featuring floral motifs and surrounded by a decorative chain. Two winged angels, dressed in robes, stand on either side holding the chain. The background has fine lines and the word "FIDES" is inscribed above.

artworks.title: The Four Evangelists
artworks.description: The image shows four elderly men around a table. They have long hair and beards, and appear focused as they write or take notes on tablets. They wear classical robes and sit in different postures, engaged in writing or possibly calculating. Two hold writing implements and tablets, while a third holds a scroll. Above them, a seated figure with wings is present. Light rays emanate from a dove at the top, highlighting a celestial influence. An eagle is perched nearby. Architectural elements like columns and arches are in the background. A lion's head is under the table.

artworks.title: Mater Dolorosa
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with their head and upper shoulders visible. The person is facing forward with their head slightly tilted upwards and to the side, looking into the distance. Their facial features include a pronounced brow, closed lips, and eyes looking upwards. They have smooth, light skin and dark hair mostly covered by a draped cloth, which envelops their head and neck. The person wears simple, monochrome clothing resembling classical or religious attire. They are not holding any objects or wearing noticeable jewelry. The background has textured, parallel lines creating a gradient effect. The portrait is framed by an oval border with an intricate design at the bottom, featuring a coat of arms and two lion-like figures.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person has their head tilted upwards, eyes gazing towards the sky. Their facial features include a long, straight nose, high cheekbones, and a slightly open mouth. They have long, wavy, dark hair cascading around the shoulders. The person is wearing a crown of thorns and has a beard. They are clothed in a simple draped garment with texture indicated by shading. The scene is framed by an oval shape and rays emanate from the head, creating a halo effect. The background is composed of etched lines, providing a gradient effect and depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Christ Full-Length
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright on a stylized rock or mound. The person is facing forward with the left hand raised and fingers extended, and the right hand lowered. He has long, wavy hair, a beard, and a mustache. The clothing is a long, flowing robe with deep folds draped around his body. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain. At the bottom of the illustration, there is a block of text in Latin.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The engraving shows three figures: two adults and an infant. On the left, a kneeling adult faces the other figures. The adult on the right sits, holding the unclothed infant. The figures are in a simple setting with draped fabric, stones, a column on the left, and a donkey in the background. Natural elements like branches are also visible. A stone slab on the ground bears inscribed text.

artworks.title: Vincent Voiture
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait with his upper body, including shoulders and part of his chest, visible. He faces the viewer with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has a mustache, narrow beard, long and narrow nose, high cheekbones, slender lips, and long wavy hair falling past his shoulders. He wears a collared shirt with a bow and a jacket with ornate patterns on the sleeves. The portrait frame is oval with engravings, and the background has a cross-hatched texture. Below the portrait is a rectangular plaque with script text.

artworks.title: Marechal de Turenne
artworks.description: This image shows a half-length portrait of a man dressed in historical attire within an oval frame. The man is positioned slightly angled towards the left with a steady gaze directed at the viewer. He has a mustache and a pointed goatee, long wavy hair, and wears an elaborate lace collar over a detailed jacket. There are castle turret illustrations in the background corners and stenciled text within the frame.
